newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney completes Eckerd tender.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney completes Eckerd tender.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co. said Monday it completed its $35-a-share cash tender offer for roughly 35.3 million common shares of drug store operator Eckerd Corp. on Friday.
The Plano, Tex.-based retailer said it had accepted for payment only about 59.5 percent of the roughly 59.3 million Eckerd shares tendered to its Omega Acquisition Corp. unit.
Penney said it expects to announce and pay the final proration percentage for the shares within the next seven business days.
It added that it expected to complete the $3.3 billion acquisition during the first quarter of 1997.
Eckerd's drug stores will be merged into Penney's Thrift Drug division.
Eckerd's stock fell 25 cents to $33.75, while Penney rose 37.5 cents to $51.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
